selection: rocprofv3 kernel trace of DeepSeek-V4-Flash decode, eager, TP=1, batch 1; cases are the three dispatched layer classes distinguished by launch geometry under the full aggregation key

provenance.how_captured: rocprofv3 --kernel-trace --marker-trace, windowed to a roctx range around the measured generate; warmup outside the window; 255 generated tokens; MI355X gfx950, ROCm 7.2.2, single dedicated GPU
provenance.aggregation_key: grid(x,y,z) + workgroup(x,y,z) + VGPR + Accum_VGPR + SGPR + LDS + Scratch
provenance.validity_check: dispatches per class divide to exact integers per token: 21.00 / 20.00 / 2.00, summing to the 43 layers
provenance.layer_taxonomy: compress_ratios over 43 layers gives 21 at ratio 4 (indexed, top-512), 20 at ratio 128 (compressed cache), 2 at ratio 0 (layers 0 and 1, sliding window). Confirmed independently by indexer-GEMM launch count, _inverse_rope_gptj_kernel counts, and these geometries.
provenance.attended_token_bound: index_topk=512 caps C4 layers at 512 attended tokens at ANY context length; C128 layers see ceil(ctx/128); sliding_window=128 bounds the residual layers. Long context does not produce long K in this model.
provenance.grid_note: rocprofv3 Grid_Size is work-items. grid=(num_queries, num_splits, heads_blocks) in workgroups; observed num_splits 16/8/4 and heads_blocks 4.
provenance.timing_caveat: decode_gpu_share_eager values below are shares of summed GPU time over decode-phase kernels under eager execution, NOT Arena gpu_pct and NOT comparable to Hyperloom production percentages. Graph-replayed decode is unobservable by rocprofv3 (aborts or degrades) and by Kineto (cannot see into a replay), so eager is the only observable regime.
